**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant binding Mortgage Logic.com:

- **§ 8 (Client covenants)** — limited to compliance with consumer credit/privacy laws, non-representation about underwriting decisions, access limitation, the Credit Data licence, Client Content warranties and anti-spamming. No personnel restriction.
- **§ 7** — the only "unsolicited" language concerns commercial e-mail/spam, not employees.
- **§ 10 (Confidentiality)** and **§§ 13–30 (boilerplate)** — no covenant restricting hiring or solicitation of either party's staff.
- **§ 4** — TrueLink must make a named programmer available for Support Services, but no restriction attaches to that individual.

Because the preferred position ("no non-solicit on Customer") is already satisfied, no redline was proposed. One diligence note carried in the rationale rather than as a deviation: § 8(d) cross-refers to a separate **Non-Competition Agreement** (concerning Credit Data use) that is not part of this document — that instrument should be reviewed separately in case it carries a personnel covenant.
